diagnosis.condition: The locked canonical rearm script correctly classifies H9 as a blocked generic-evaluation window and launches H9 supervisors, but its legacy idempotency process-name list predates the H9-specific watcher names. At treatment cutover, the control completion supervisor would therefore survive while a second treatment-side completion supervisor was launched.

correction.exact_action: After the treatment manifest passes its locked identity checks and before invoking canonical rearm, require zero or one Python completion supervisor whose command line contains both v5_hybrid_h9_completion_watch.py and the exact control run id; fail closed on more than one; stop the single prior supervisor if present; then invoke the unchanged canonical rearm.
